actions.text: Committee on Indian Affairs. Hearings held.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Indian Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Directly affects American Indian and Alaska Native patients who receive purchased/referred care services through the Indian Health Service.
dimensions.evidence: a patient who receives purchased/referred care authorized by the Service

dimensions.assessment: Protects patients from medical debt collection and mandates timely 30-day reimbursements for out-of-pocket payments on authorized care.
dimensions.evidence: not liable to any provider, debt collector, or any other person for the payment of any charges or costs

dimensions.assessment: Imposes administrative reimbursement requirements on the Indian Health Service, though total funding changes are not specified.
dimensions.evidence: to be reimbursed by the Service for that payment not later than 30 days after the date on which the patient submits documentation

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Indian Health Care Improvement Act, updates the Indian Health Manual, and renames contract health services to purchased/referred care throughout federal statutes.
dimensions.evidence: The Indian Health Care Improvement Act (25 U.S.C. 1601 et seq.) is amended-- (A) by striking contract health service each place it appears and inserting purchased/referred care

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent liability protections, reimbursement procedures, and statutory name changes.
dimensions.evidence: shall apply to purchased/referred care... furnished on, before, or after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Specific appropriations or budgetary allocations required to fulfill the reimbursement mandates are not included in the source text.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the Indian Health Service to reimburse patients within 30 days for out-of-pocket costs of authorized purchased/referred care, shields patients from liability for unpaid care costs within 5 business days of notification, and updates administrative manuals and statutory terminology.
